name: Site01 LOLA
encoding: Float32 little endian; north to south

peak: Maximum of 4x4 native pixels for sampled horizon, conservative spatial aggregation
slope: Maximum native central-difference slope in each 20m cell

limitations: 20m aggregation and angular/radial sampling do not resolve every obstruction
